class ThrowsBeforeReturning {
  value;
  constructor() {
    try { throw 0; }
    finally { this.value = 1; return; }
  }
}
class ThrowsInHandler {
  value;
  constructor() {
    try { throw 0; }
    catch { this.value = 'caught'; throw 1; }
    finally { this.value = 'returned'; return; }
  }
}
class CompletesOrThrows {
  value;
  constructor(flag: boolean) {
    try {
      if (!flag) throw 0;
      this.value = 2;
    } finally {
      if (!flag) { this.value = 3; return; }
    }
  }
}
class Nested {
  value;
  constructor() {
    try {
      try { throw 0; }
      finally { this.value = "visited"; }
    } finally {
      this.value ??= "returned";
      return;
    }
  }
}
console.log(new ThrowsBeforeReturning().value.toFixed(), new ThrowsInHandler().value.toUpperCase());
console.log(new CompletesOrThrows(false).value.toFixed(), new CompletesOrThrows(true).value.toFixed());
console.log(new Nested().value.toUpperCase());
